purpose: map a stable managed-identity subject to exactly one stable Campus principal without using username as authorization

columns.name: IDENTITY_ID
columns.description: Campus-generated UUID for the identity mapping row

uniqueness: PROVIDER+PROVIDER_SUB resolves to exactly one row
one MIGRATED row may not share the same PROVIDER+PROVIDER_SUB with any other row
one active provider identity may not map to multiple LOCAL_SOURCE+LOCAL_KEY_TYPE+LOCAL_KEY principals
migration_invariants: MIGRATED requires exactly one local principal
MIGRATED requires legacy reusable secret cleared or an explicit atomic cleanup step in the same controlled migration
LEGACY_CLEARED_AT must be populated before a migrated account is declared SEC-001 compliant
provider subject/token/password are never written to audit logs beyond the required mapping subject itself
NOTES_CODE uses controlled codes, never free-text PII
